i keep sending people to this and they never find it on their own, so here's exactly where to tap 🤍

open longlivets.com and hit the Merch tab — the little shopping-bag icon at the bottom. then pick any era you want.

every outfit under 'Seen on Taylor' is a real photo of her look, and tapping the tile opens the actual store in a new tab. it's labeled 'her look, not the product' so you always know exactly what you're buying.

there's also a whole 'Made by Swifties' shelf — 22 fan-made pieces from independent shops.

go open your era and find one: longlivets.com/?mode=merch&utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch

consider this your permission to go shopping 🤍 tap the little shopping-bag tab, open whichever era owns your heart, and see the real pieces behind her looks. every photo links straight out to where it's sold. go treat yourself.

the number that surprised me building The Runway: 39. 🤍

39 real photographs, from her very first CMA red carpet in 2006 all the way to now — pulled together into 15 signature looks across all 12 eras.

not a single illustration or mockup. every image is a credited press or tour photo, from the gold fringe of Fearless to the cottagecore cardigans of folklore.

scroll her whole style evolution in one place: longlivets.com/?lens=fashion&utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=thread

15 looks. all 12 eras. 39 real red-carpet and tour photographs, every single one credited to the photographer who shot it. that's The Runway, and building it made me fall for her style evolution all over again 🤍

This is Taylor in 2007, right at the very start of it all. A guitar, curls for days, and a debut album she'd written as a teenager — full of songs about heartbreaks the world had never heard of yet 🥹

This is exactly where Blank Spaces begins. Not with a famous name, but with a small-town kid writing about her own crushes, years before any of the relationships you already know. Our timeline is confirmed-only: it maps who she actually wrote about and when, sourced every step, no rumors and no guessing.

It's the quietest chapter of the whole story and honestly my favorite. Start right here at the beginning and watch it grow up alongside her →

Photo: Taylor in 2007 — Brian Cantoni (CC BY 2.0), via Wikimedia Commons.

longlivets.com/?lens=love-story&utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=timeline

Every love story has a prologue. Hers is a Pennsylvania teenager writing songs about boys who never made the news — years before the famous ones. That's the era our relationship map opens on. Receipts only, no speculation 🤍

longlivets.com/?lens=love-story&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=timeline

That ivory gown from the willow video — the one half the fandom swore was a secret wedding dress the second it dropped 😭 (Zimmermann said it was actually inspired by lucky charms and fortune-telling, for the record.)

Here's what Seen on Taylor does with a look like that: tap it, and it sends you straight to the exact Jennifer Behr 'Priscilla' tiara she wore with it — a real piece you can actually find, not a guess. The gown itself sold out ages ago, but the crown lives on.

And because we're fans, not a shop pretending to be official, every tile says the same thing: her look, not the product. We just point you to what she wore 🤍

Open your favorite era and find one →

Photo: the evermore set, Eras Tour, Inglewood 2023 — Paolo Villanueva (CC BY 2.0), via Wikimedia Commons.

Ever lose an hour hunting down one thing Taylor wore? We built the fix. That willow-era Jennifer Behr headpiece now sits behind a single credited retailer link — real match, no detective work. Her look, not the product 🤍

Pick one, and you're not allowed to say both 😭

Two songs. Both take a real heartbreak and turn it into a whole short film:

"Dear John" — seven minutes of the quietest, most surgical hurt she's ever put on a record.

"All Too Well (10 Minute Version)" — ten minutes, the scarf, an entire stadium screaming every line back at her.

Which one actually leaves you more wrecked? I need a real answer, not a diplomatic one — drop it below and tag the friend who'll fight you on it 🤍

They both live in Blank Spaces, our thread mapping every era's heartbreak song in one place. Go open it, then come argue:

Photo: Taylor on the Speak Now set of the Eras Tour, Inglewood 2023 — Paolo Villanueva (CC BY 2.0), via Wikimedia Commons.
